effective_date: Upon full execution by the parties unless otherwise specified.
payment_terms: Both parties may contribute cash at different times; agreement should specify ownership percentages, profit split, repayment of any fronted money, and rules for handling cash sales (no secret taking of cash sales).
purpose: Establish a clear, professional partnership for operating a mobile coffee cart for summer events, including ownership, decision-making, profit sharing, money contributions and repayment, compliance responsibilities, equipment and operational rules, accounting transparency, exit/buyout, and restrictions on cash handling and competing branding.
